sourceLineage.origin: Stem investor relations — financial results index

observations: Q2 revenue was $33.7M, down 12% year over year, while software/services/edge-hardware revenue was $33.4M, up 1%; PowerTrack software revenue rose 11% year over year.
GAAP gross margin improved to 41% from 33%; adjusted EBITDA was $6.2M, up 63%, and operating cash flow was positive $0.3M versus negative $21.3M a year earlier.
Bookings rose 39% sequentially to $36.8M, backlog rose 18% sequentially to $27.1M, and management reaffirmed 2026 guidance.
factors: software mix and cost discipline are lifting margins
positive adjusted EBITDA and operating cash flow indicate improving operating leverage
bookings/backlog growth and PowerTrack expansion provide forward demand evidence
risks: total revenue still contracted year over year
cash balance of $38.4M leaves less room for execution error than larger peers
reported net loss remains negative despite adjusted EBITDA progress
contradictions: Improving margins, bookings and recurring software metrics coexist with declining total revenue; turnaround quality depends on sustained software growth rather than hardware-mix contraction alone.
unknowns: durability of positive operating cash flow across multiple quarters
conversion rate/timing of backlog into recurring high-margin revenue

recommendation.reason: Current primary evidence provides reusable growth, margin, cash-flow and backlog inputs while preserving the revenue-growth contradiction for underwriting.
